030828: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_usual_arithmetic_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId left_type, IrTypeId right_type)
030829: {
030830:     IrType* left = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, left_type);
030831:     IrType* right = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, right_type);
030832:     if (!left || !right)
030833:     {
030834:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
030835:     }
030836:     // One complex operand makes the result complex, over the usual arithmetic
030837:     // type of the two corresponding real types (C11 6.3.1.8p1).
030838:     if (left->is_complex || right->is_complex)
030839:     {
030840:         return c_ir_complex_result_type(builder, left_type, right_type);
030841:     }
030842:     if (left->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || left->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM || (left->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && left->bit_width < 32))
030843:     {
030844:         left_type = builder->s32_type;
030845:         left = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, left_type);
030846:     }
030847:     if (right->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || right->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM || (right->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && right->bit_width < 32))
030848:     {
030849:         right_type = builder->s32_type;
030850:         right = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, right_type);
030851:     }
030852:     bool left_arithmetic = left && (left->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || left->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT);
030853:     bool right_arithmetic = right && (right->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || right->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT);
030854:     if (!left_arithmetic || !right_arithmetic)
030855:     {
030856:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
030857:     }
030858:     if (left->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT || right->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
030859:     {
030860:         if (left->kind != IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
030861:         {
030862:             return right_type;
030863:         }
030864:         if (right->kind != IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
030865:         {
030866:             return left_type;
030867:         }
030868:         return c_ir_float_conversion_rank(right) > c_ir_float_conversion_rank(left) ? right_type : left_type;
030869:     }
030870:     if (left_type.value == right_type.value)
030871:     {
030872:         return left_type;
030873:     }
030874:     if (left->is_signed == right->is_signed)
030875:     {
030876:         return right->bit_width > left->bit_width ? right_type : left_type;
030877:     }
030878:     IrTypeId signed_type = left->is_signed ? left_type : right_type;
030879:     IrTypeId unsigned_type = left->is_signed ? right_type : left_type;
030880:     IrType* signed_value = left->is_signed ? left : right;
030881:     IrType* unsigned_value = left->is_signed ? right : left;
030882:     IrTypeId result;
030883:     if (unsigned_value->bit_width >= signed_value->bit_width)
030884:     {
030885:         result = unsigned_type;
030886:     }
030887:     else
030888:     {
030889:         result = signed_type;
030890:     }
030891: 
030892:     return result;
030893: }

030895: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_type_is_integer_domain(IrType* type)
030896: {
030897:     return type && (type->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || type->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM);
030898: }

030900: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_range_is_null_pointer_constant_attempt(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId type_id, u32 start, u32 end)
030901: {
030902:     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
030903:     // C11 6.3.2.3p3 gives a null pointer constant two spellings: an integer
030904:     // constant expression with the value 0, *or* such an expression cast to
030905:     // `void *`.  The second is not a rewording of the first -- it is the only
030906:     // one that survives being written as a conditional operand, and musl's
030907:     // <tgmath.h> is built out of exactly that: `0 ? (t*)0 : (void*)!(c)`
030908:     // selects `t` or `void` purely on whether the `void *` arm is a null
030909:     // pointer constant.
030910:     bool void_pointer = type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_POINTER && !type->is_nullptr;
030911:     if (void_pointer)
030912:     {
030913:         IrType* pointee = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type->element_type);
030914:         void_pointer = pointee && pointee->kind == IR_TYPE_VOID;
030915:     }
030916:     if (!c_ir_type_is_integer_domain(type) && !void_pointer)
030917:     {
030918:         return false;
030919:     }
030920:     CIrConstantValue value = {0};
030921:     if (!c_ir_query_constant(builder, start, end, &value))
030922:     {
030923:         return false;
030924:     }
030925:     // A `void *` operand folds through the cast rule in c_ir_constant_cast,
030926:     // which turns a zero integer into a symbol-less pointer constant and
030927:     // fails outright on any other value -- so `(void *)1` never arrives here
030928:     // as a constant at all.
030929:     if (void_pointer)
030930:     {
030931:         return value.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER && value.symbol.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && !value.addend && !value.integer;
